purpose: Compare course options associated with 50 colleges/universities in Chhattisgarh by course name, typical duration, career opportunities and real-life career examples.

fields_explained.courses_for_comparison: Course comparisons associated with the institution's broad discipline
fields_explained.typical_duration: Typical duration; may vary by current rules and program structure
fields_explained.career_opportunities: Possible career paths, not guaranteed outcomes
fields_explained.real_life_example: Sourced illustration where possible; clearly labels when course-specific alumni evidence is not verified

quality_and_scope_notes: Contains 50 institution records located in Chhattisgarh.
The institution list combines official-directory names and a starter compilation; verify exact official name, current operation, affiliation, and course availability.
Course options shown by broad discipline are a comparison template and must not be interpreted as confirmation that every listed course is currently offered at that exact college.
No invented college-specific placement rates, salary figures, or student enrollment counts are included.
Real-life examples are carefully caveated; most examples are field-level rather than institution-specific because reliable alumni-course links were not available for every program.
